description: Scanner - disk space usage visualizer drawing the whole drive as a sunburst chart
notes: Pinned to 2.13 (July 2012) - the download URL carries no version and upstream has been dormant since, so there is nothing for checkver to watch.
Settings (window position, colors) live in the registry under HKCU\Software\Steffen Gerlach - scoop neither persists nor removes them.
The bundled 'Add Scanner to Context Menu.reg' hardcodes C:\Program Files\Scanner - edit the path to ...\apps\scanner\current\Scanner.exe before importing if you want the right-click entry.
The site is HTTP-only, no TLS - the pinned hash is what guarantees integrity.
